items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s the night I played with Lionel [Hampton], wasn’t it?

ctx.x: Yeah, in the Rose Garden, Carter.
That’s the night I played with Lionel [Hampton], wasn’t it? Lionel had told us what he’s going to play. He didn’t play one thing that he told us. That great bass player . . .
